successors.name: Sultanate of Kedah
successors.text: Kedah, where 'King Phra Ong Mahawangsa converted to Islam and adopted the name Sultan Mudzafar Shah'

ledger.x: c. 330: Old Kedah begins. The Kedah Sultanate page labels the predecessor state 'Old Kedah (330-1136)' and lists a first Durbar Raja at 330-390 with dates it calls speculative; the Bujang Valley page has a brick monument 'dating back to 110 AD' and Hindus arriving 'around 170 CE'. The founding year is a page label…
634: a new kingdom is formed in Kedah.

c. 682-685: Srivijaya conquers Kedah. Srivijaya infobox 'Conquest of Kedah: c. 682-685'; Kalah/Kedah is among Srivijaya's main urban centres 'Muara Jambi and Kedah'. The srivijaya dossier carries the matching gain at 685.
1026: Kedah is again its own kingdom.
1136: the king of Kedah becomes a Muslim sultan.

wars.name: Chola raids on Kadaram (Kedah)
wars.outcome: 'Between 1017 and 1025, the Chola Empire raided the main Malay ports ... including Kedah' and captured its king; Virarajendra 'conquered Kadaram (Kedah) and gave it back to its king'; 'Kulottunga stayed in Kadaram (Kedah) after the naval expedition of 1067'…

certainty.note: The page gives the Bujang Valley's size but no frontier; the whole of Kedah state is a coarse stand-in.
